record_spec.gate_c_axis_evaluation: see docs/handbooks/architecture-methodology.md, section 'Axis evaluation procedure — alignment' for the READ/EXECUTE/CRITERIA/CITATION method this role's axis_evaluation entries must follow: EXECUTE recomputes the record's overall verdict as the worst-case result across all cited test entries in EARL's fixed severity order (failed > cantTell > inapplicable > untested > passed) and compares it against any standalone summary verdict asserted, per EARL 1.0 Schema (W3C, https://www.w3.org/TR/EARL10-Schema/).

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: overall verdict = the worst-case result across all cited test entries (failed > cantTell > inapplicable > untested > passed), never a standalone summary field asserted independently of the cited results (issue-515 invariant 4).

reference_resolution.rule: test must resolve to the actual conformance criterion (a spec section, requirement, or lint rule) being checked, not a vague description; subject must resolve to a real repo path or commit sha. Each axis_evaluation ref must resolve to a real entry inside this record carrying axis (must be in this role's judgment_axes), verdict (supports|contradicts|no-opinion), and citation (a docs/product/*.md entry path); when verdict is contradicts, the entry must also carry a finding object with target_path (must resolve against some role's write_scope) and a non-empty required_fix (issue-573 architecture proposal, sections 1 and 6).

use_when.board_condition: an implementation commit landed on the branch AND no conformance-review record exists yet for this commit sha
